name: PanNuke: Open Pan-Cancer Histology Dataset for Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification
description: PanNuke is a comprehensive pan-cancer histology benchmark for nuclear instance segmentation and classification across 19 human tissue types (including adrenal gland, bile duct, bladder, breast, cervix, colon, esophagus, head & neck, kidney, liver, lung, ovary, pancreas, prostate, skin, stomach, testis, thyroid, and uterus). It contains 7,901 visual field patches of 256x256 pixels at 40x magnification, with 189,744 exhaustively annotated nuclei classified into 5 clinical categories: neoplastic, non-neoplastic epithelial, inflammatory, connective tissue, and dead. Distributed with 3 standardized randomized cross-validation folds (Fold 1: 2,656 patches, Fold 2: 2,523 patches, Fold 3: 2,722 patches).
